method.s: Place a large roasting dish, large enough to hold the cheesecake tin, half filled with very hot water, into the centre of the oven.
Lightly grease a 24cm loose-bottomed springform tin. Cover the outside with two layers of tinfoil to create a waterproof outer.
Crush biscuits into crumbs then mix with melted butter and sugar. Press firmly into base of pan.
Melt white chocolate in a metal bowl over a bain marie. Stir until just melted, then take off the heat.
In a food processor mix cream cheese and caster sugar until smooth. Mix in cornflour, eggs, lemon juice, vanilla and salt.
Add sour cream and blend until completely smooth, then blend in melted white chocolate.
Pour over the base in the springform pan and carefully place into water-filled roasting dish. The water should come two-thirds of the way up the pan.

Bake for 50 minutes, then turn oven off and leave undisturbed for an hour to cool. The cheesecake should be firm but still wobble a little when you shake the pan gently. Once it cools it will firm up to the correct consistency.
Place tin on a cake rack and cool for another hour. Cover in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

To remove from tin, have a large serving plate ready. Remove tinfoil, then slowly release the springform outer. Use a large knife to loosen the cheesecake from the metal base. Slide carefully onto serving plate.
Top with raspberry coulis to serve.
